author: Mark Atwood
text: RFC 6550 section 7.2 contradicts the issue premise: 128..255 is linear, 0..127 circular, and both same-region cases with absolute difference >16 are incomparable. Began correcting the actual modulo-before-magnitude bug across DODAG Python/Rust/C while preserving the explicit DODAG 127->0 caller policy, but an external shared-worktree worker then overwrote python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py with the reversed premise implementation. Stopped to avoid collision. Partial RFC-correct changes/tests remain in Rust/C and focused test files; Python focused gate currently has 5 expected collision-caused failures.
